verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is per-request cookie forwarding via the `X-Set-Cookie` header. The caller must resupply cookies on every request, so this is an adjacent control, not a persistent browser profile that keeps cookies and login state across requests. The S3 cache stores fetched pages, not browser session state, and nothing in the pack documents persistent profiles or sessions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse a persistent browser profile with saved cookies and login state across multiple requests

citations.quote: Pass your session cookies with the `X-Set-Cookie` header and the Reader forwards them when fetching the URL
